name: melvin-guardrails
description: Deterministic guardrail hooks: protected files, destructive commands, secrets, sensitive logging, financial core and migration protection, post-edit checks, verification before stop, session context.

run_project_commands.title: Run project check commands
run_project_commands.description: Allow guardrail hooks to run the format, lint, typecheck and verify commands a project defines in .claude/guardrails.json. Those commands come from the repository, so enable this only if you trust the repositories you open.
